items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: Well, we had a few substitutes like Buster, you got on drums. I don't know him.

ctx.x: Roland was on alto. Yeah, alto.

Roland Lee. And we had Charlie Fabry on drums. That's right. He also died. And then, uh... Well, we had a few substitutes like Buster, you got on drums. I don't know him. Well, I mean, he was a fine, you know, drummer. And then they had, you see, the three Mike Lawlers, I mean, each other had some good. A little black mic and a red mic. And also, old man Jack Assunto, a trombone. He played a few... And a lot of leaders, you know, tried to get that job by the time we grew up in the Union, but we had the job sewed…
